name: MatchOfficialAppointmentsManager
tagline: Appoint referees and assistants to every fixture – with grade, availability, conflict-of-interest, rest, workload and travel rules built in.
description: A complete officials appointments app for leagues and associations: dashboard KPIs, fixtures list with bulk actions, officials × days week grid, roster with assessments, and a fees and mileage payment run. Ranked candidates with reasons, auto-appoint, offer/accept/decline/confirm workflow and assessor marks against a pass mark. Runs in demo mode instantly and connects to collections, Dataverse, SharePoint or the Power Pages Web API.
features: Ranked candidates with Best match and not-eligible reasons
Auto-appoint for a week or a selection
Grade vs competition level rules; assistants required from a level
Conflict of interest with home/away club
Minimum rest between kick-offs and weekly game limit
Travel warnings from a region distance table
Offer → accept/decline → confirm → complete workflow with blocking reasons
Fees by level, assistant %, return mileage, payment CSV
Search, quick filters, grouping, bulk actions, undo
Phone layout with bottom bar and card lists
